name: Emplifi Social Marketing Cloud
description_en:
Emplifi Social Marketing Cloud is the catalog’s legacy name for the social marketing part of Emplifi’s current platform. The assigned product URL now redirects to the broader Emplifi site. This profile focuses on Publisher, governed team collaboration, campaign organization and social-response operations. Social Care and Social Commerce are separately packaged; their full capabilities should not be imported into a Social Marketing feature list.

The relevant task is coordinating content across profiles and teams with explicit review and publication responsibilities. A useful evaluation follows one approved asset into each destination, its schedule, campaign metadata and final native-platform result. Current AI positioning does not remove account permissions, enabled-feature conditions, platform restrictions or manual recovery work. No live account, publishing experiment or measured commercial outcome was used in this research.
description_zh:
Emplifi Social Marketing Cloud 是目录中对应 Emplifi 当前平台社交营销部分的旧名称。指定产品网址现跳转至更广泛 Emplifi 官网。本文聚焦 Publisher、团队权限协作、活动组织及社交回复操作。Social Care、Social Commerce 分别打包，不能把其全部能力并入 Social Marketing 功能表。

相关任务是以明确审阅及发布职责跨账户、团队协调内容。有效评估可跟踪一个获批素材进入各目的地、对应时刻、活动元数据及原生平台最终结果。当前 AI 定位不能取消账户权限、能力开关、平台限制或人工恢复工作。本研究未操作真实账户、进行发布实验或测量商业效果。

core_features.explanation_en: Create and preview content for selected social profiles.
core_features.explanation_zh: 为所选社交账户创建及预览内容。

core_features.explanation_en: Product, resource and role permissions jointly define access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 产品、资源及角色共同定义访问。

core_features.explanation_en: Flexible flows return rejected content to an earlier stage.
core_features.explanation_zh: Flexible Flow 将拒绝内容退回更早阶段。

core_features.explanation_en: Campaign dates and identifiers constrain and classify posts.
core_features.explanation_zh: 活动日期及标识约束、分类帖子。

en: Coordinate headquarters and regional content with separate approval of adapted copies.
Plan a multi-platform launch with per-platform timing and campaign metadata.
Evaluate crisis-stop coverage and response recovery before adopting a publishing process.
zh: 协调总部与区域内容，对修改副本分别审批。
按平台时间及活动元数据规划多平台发布。
采用发布流程前评估危机停发覆盖与回复恢复。
use_cases.basis: Editorial workflow examples; not observed customer outcomes.

specific_roles.zh: 企业社交媒体运营负责人

steps.en: Identify Teams or legacy governance and map required profiles.
steps.zh: 确认 Teams 或旧模型，绘制所需账户。

steps.en: Prepare a controlled post and inspect each approximate preview.
steps.zh: 准备可控帖子，分别检查近似预览。

steps.en: Exercise rejection and resubmission in the applicable flow.
steps.zh: 在适用流程检查拒绝及重新提交。

steps.en: Check per-platform time, campaign date and current metadata.
steps.zh: 检查各平台时间、活动日期及现行元数据。

steps.en: Review native outcomes, failure states and emergency exceptions.
steps.zh: 检查原生结果、失败状态及紧急停发例外。

items.en: Advanced approval needs the documented account toggle; post flow absence can permit the ordinary publish route.
items.zh: 高级审批需对应账户开关，缺少 Post Flow 可能进入普通发布路径。

items.en: Stop Publishing excludes several scheduled groups and does not stop new scheduling.
items.zh: Stop Publishing 排除若干计划组，也不停止新排程。

items.en: Campaign tracking edits do not retroactively rewrite existing assigned posts.
items.zh: 活动跟踪编辑不追溯改写已关联帖子。

items.en: Previews are approximate and generated replies still need a final send action.
items.zh: 预览是近似效果，生成回复仍需最终发送动作。

pricing.source_snapshot_en: Current Social Marketing cards show Essential starting at $1,249/month and Advanced at $2,499/month; Intelligent is quoted. These are starting amounts, not a verified fixed account total or annual contract equivalent. Social Care and Social Commerce have separate packages. Billing term, usage units, taxes, onboarding charges, trial eligibility and exact feature entitlements require a quote; no permanent free plan was verified.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 当前 Social Marketing 卡片 Essential 每月 $1,249 起，Advanced 每月 $2,499 起，Intelligent 询价。这是起价，未核实为固定账户总额或年约折合价。Social Care、Social Commerce 有独立组合。计费期限、用量单位、税、入门费用、试用及准确功能资格需报价，未核实永久免费计划。

review_notes: Original English and corresponding Chinese research draft. Vendor statements describe documented behavior, not independently measured quality.
Existing third-party source is discovery-only and superseded. Unknown UI languages, regional availability and licensing remain unknown.
All publication and alternative-relationship states remain unapproved.

sections.title_en: Identify the account’s access model before setup
sections.title_zh: 设置前确认账户权限模型
sections.en: Settings showing Team management identifies Teams; Roles & permissions identifies the legacy model. Current Teams combine enabled products, resources and user roles. If the same user and resource appear in several teams, permissions combine across those roles. Collaborative visibility of another person does not itself grant their resources. Editorial regional setup: map profiles and actions first, then inspect overlapping memberships so a supposedly limited reviewer does not receive publishing ability elsewhere. Legacy profile-role recipes are useful only when that is the account’s actual model.
sections.zh: Settings 出现 Team management 表示 Teams，Roles & permissions 表示旧模型。当前 Teams 结合启用产品、资源及用户角色。同一用户及资源出现在多个团队时，相关角色权限合并。看见其他团队人员本身不授予资源访问。编辑区域设置建议：先绘制账户及动作，再检查重叠成员关系，避免受限审阅者从别处取得发布能力。旧 profile-role 配方仅适用于真实使用旧模型的账户。

sections.title_en: The preview is approximate, and the selected destination matters
sections.title_zh: 预览是近似效果，目的地选择重要
sections.en: Composer selects one or more profiles, a compatible media type and any visible required label groups. The official guide explicitly calls its preview approximate; LinkedIn document preview shows only the first page, and page counts are PDF-only. Editorial asset check: inspect the actual document and platform-specific media requirements before scheduling. A visually plausible first-page preview does not validate every page, every destination or final delivery. Publish is a live action, so draft preparation and final scheduling should have explicit owners.
sections.zh: Composer 选择一个或多个账户、兼容媒体类型及可见必填标签组。官方指南明确称预览是近似效果，LinkedIn 文档只预览第一页，页数仅 PDF 提供。编辑素材检查建议：排程前查看真实文档及平台媒体要求。第一页看似正确不能验证所有页面、目的地或最终投递。Publish 是真实动作，因此草稿准备及最终排程需明确负责人。

sections.title_en: Use per-platform scheduling and recognize delegated Facebook posts
sections.title_zh: 按平台排程，并识别交给 Facebook 的帖子
sections.en: Single-platform multiposting uses one time; selecting several platforms enables customized times per platform. Scheduling supports user or page timezone. PrimeTime recommendations cover Facebook, Instagram and TikTok and can be unavailable when data is insufficient. The single-Facebook Generate post ID option sends the scheduled post to Facebook, prevents editing text/attachments and has asymmetric deletion: deleting in Publisher removes it from Facebook, while deleting in Meta does not remove it from Publisher. Editorial launch check: record which system now owns the scheduled item before changing it or invoking emergency controls.
sections.zh: 单平台多账户排程使用同一时间，多平台选择可分别定时。支持用户或页面时区。PrimeTime 覆盖 Facebook、Instagram、TikTok，数据不足时可能不可用。单 Facebook 的 Generate post ID 会把计划帖交给 Facebook，之后不能编辑文字／附件，删除也不对称：Publisher 删除会删除 Facebook 内容，Meta 删除不移除 Publisher 记录。编辑发布检查：修改或调用紧急控制前，先记录计划项现由哪个系统持有。

sections.title_en: Select reviewers with permission, not just a notification address
sections.title_zh: 按权限选择审阅者，不能只填通知地址
sections.en: Standard approval can notify selected people with approval permissions. Flexible flows move content through stages, with rejection to an earlier stage and a reason, followed by correction and resubmission. Creating flows requires Account Admin or Manage Approval flows permission. The example uses legacy profile roles; apply the current account’s governance instructions instead of granting broad administration merely to imitate the example. Editorial product announcement: separate content review from the client’s final decision, and verify the actual route before scheduling a deadline-dependent post.
sections.zh: Standard Approval 可通知所选具有审批权限的人。Flexible Flow 逐阶段推进，拒绝时附原因退回更早阶段，修正后重新提交。创建流程需 Account Admin 或 Manage Approval flows 权限。示例使用旧 profile role，应遵循当前账户模型，不应为了复刻示例授予宽泛管理权。编辑产品公告示例：内容审阅与客户最终决策分开，在排入有期限帖子前确认真实路径。

sections.title_en: An Approved Draft is a reusable master, not a publishable post
sections.title_zh: Approved Draft 是可复用母稿，不能直接发布
sections.en: Advanced Approval Flows require Teams and the AdvancedApprovalEngine toggle. Draft-type approval creates a read-only, unpublishable master; its duplicate is a new post without inherited approval. Matching uses content type, author team role and profiles. Cross-team ambiguity blocks sending, but no matching post flow uses the ordinary publish path. Conditional label stages are fixed at submission and re-read only after rejection to the start. Editorial global campaign: verify matching and labels before submission; HQ approval does not approve a market’s edited copy.
sections.zh: 高级审批需 Teams 及 AdvancedApprovalEngine 开关。Draft 类型审批生成只读、不可发布母稿，复制品是新帖，不继承审批。匹配使用内容类型、作者团队角色及账户。跨团队匹配冲突阻止发送，但无匹配 Post Flow 时走普通发布路径。条件标签阶段在提交时固定，仅退回起点后重读。编辑全球活动建议：提交前核对匹配及标签，总部批准不能批准市场修改后的副本。

sections.title_en: Stop Publishing is a bounded conversion to drafts
sections.title_zh: Stop Publishing 是有限范围的转草稿操作
sections.en: Account Admins can convert already scheduled content in the next 24 hours to drafts; bulk reversal is unavailable. New posts scheduled afterward still publish. Exceptions include Scheduled on Facebook, YouTube within one hour of publication and posts still in approval. A still-unapproved post approved afterward can therefore publish during the intended halt. Already approved, unpublished posts within the window are converted. Editorial crisis response: inspect these exception groups and other scheduling systems explicitly, then reschedule individual drafts only after the situation changes. This is not a persistent universal publishing lock.
sections.zh: Account Admin 可把未来 24 小时内已排程内容转为草稿，不能批量逆转。之后新排程仍会发布。例外包括 Scheduled on Facebook、距发布时间不足或等于一小时的 YouTube，以及仍在审批的帖子。因此之后获批的待审帖可能在希望停发期间发布。窗口内已获批未发布帖会转草稿。编辑危机处理建议：明确检查例外组及其他排程系统，情况变化后逐项重排。这并非持续全局发布锁。

sections.title_en: Campaign edits do not rewrite previously assigned tracking
sections.title_zh: 活动编辑不会改写此前关联的跟踪信息
sections.en: The campaign guide labels availability Enterprise, which needs mapping to the current contract rather than automatic equivalence with today’s tiers. Campaign IDs become immutable; posts are limited to the campaign date range. Editing default labels or UTM presets does not retroactively update already assigned posts, including scheduled posts retaining earlier UTM values. Editorial reporting plan: choose the campaign identifier before assignment and inspect actual scheduled links after a tracking change. Association labels and UTMs organize measurement; they do not independently establish incremental conversions.
sections.zh: 活动指南将资格标为 Enterprise，需与当前合约对应，不能自动等同今天的档位。活动 ID 建立后不可修改，帖子受活动日期范围约束。编辑默认标签或 UTM 预设不追溯更新已关联帖子，已有计划帖保留之前 UTM。编辑报告建议：关联前选好活动标识，修改跟踪后检查真实计划链接。关联标签及 UTM 组织测量，不独立证明增量转化。

sections.title_en: AI insertion and delivery are separate steps
sections.title_zh: 插入 AI 回复与投递是两个步骤
sections.en: In Community, Insert reply puts generated text into the editor; Reply performs the send. The guide calls for human moderation, and available reply types depend on the platform, message and permissions. Failed replies expose errors in Publishing problems and can be edited/re-sent or deleted. Sent-reply editing is documented only for Facebook comments and Google Business reviews, with further restrictions. Editorial response workflow: inspect factual claims and recipient context before Reply, and check failure state before re-sending. AI support for a language is not evidence of a localized product interface.
sections.zh: Community 中 Insert reply 将生成文本放入编辑框，Reply 才发送。指南要求人工审阅，可用回复类型受平台、消息及权限约束。失败回复在 Publishing problems 显示错误，可编辑重发或删除。已发回复编辑只记录支持 Facebook 评论及 Google Business 评价，另有条件。编辑响应建议：Reply 前核对事实及收件上下文，重发前检查失败状态。AI 支持一种语言不证明产品界面已本地化。

sections.title_en: Match the Social Marketing package to actual operational needs
sections.title_zh: 按真实运营需求匹配 Social Marketing 组合
sections.en: Emplifi separately packages marketing, care and commerce, while the website increasingly presents one AI-powered platform. Editorial fit: a distributed brand coordinating profile permissions, approvals and crisis exceptions has a different requirement from a solo account needing a simple queue. Ask the quote to name enabled products and advanced-flow access, public benchmarking limits, team count and support obligations. General AI or unlimited-user wording does not prove every predictive capability, Care module or commerce workflow is included.
sections.zh: Emplifi 分别打包营销、客服及电商，官网也越来越强调统一 AI 平台。编辑适配判断：协调多账户权限、审批及危机例外的分布式品牌，与只需简单队列的个人账户需求不同。报价应明确启用产品、高级流程资格、公开竞品额度、团队数量及支持责任。通用 AI 或不限用户文案不能证明所有预测、Care 模块或电商流程均包含。

seo.description_zh: 核对 Emplifi 团队访问、审批条件、排程例外、活动跟踪及当前起价。

seo.query_basis: Editorial intent; no search volume, ranking or AI visibility measured.

research_gaps.en: No live platform connection, publication, emergency conversion, API call, automated retry or outcome measurement was executed.
research_gaps.zh: 未执行真实平台连接、发布、紧急转草稿、API 调用、自动重试或效果测量。

research_gaps.en: Full API contract, token expiry, recovery guarantees, historical analytics retention and complete regional service restrictions were not verified.
research_gaps.zh: 未核实完整 API 契约、令牌过期、恢复保证、历史分析保留及全部地区服务限制。

research_gaps.zh: 源码许可、自托管及完整界面语言清单未知，AI 语言支持另行区分。
